# refund-return.com
> Verified US store return policies, consumer-law summaries and free letter templates. Every policy fact is taken from the store's official page, checked against the exact source sentence, and shown with its source link and last-verified date. Operated by Digital Savages LLC. Information, not legal advice.

## Key pages
- [Store return policies A–Z](https://refund-return.com/brands/)
- [Holiday return deadlines 2026](https://refund-return.com/holiday-return-deadlines/)
- [How refunds work](https://refund-return.com/refunds/)
- [How returns work](https://refund-return.com/returns/)
- [Card chargebacks (credit vs debit)](https://refund-return.com/chargebacks/)
- [Cancelling subscriptions](https://refund-return.com/cancel/)
- [Flight refunds and EU/UK261 compensation](https://refund-return.com/flights/)
- [Letter generators](https://refund-return.com/generator/) and [plain templates](https://refund-return.com/templates/)
- [Return policy generator for sellers](https://refund-return.com/sellers/return-policy-generator/)
